title: Hormuz 2027: Reopening or Prolonged Disruption?
summary:
Main
By Panagiota Kinti
It's already been six months since the disruption in the Strait of Hormuz, and the tanker market is approaching a critical crossroads. Whether the Strait reopens or remains constrained into 2027 will shape the landscape, the global oil flows and how the market absorbs a growing wave of new tanker capacity. For now, disruption continues to support freight through vessel inefficiency.
